response.query: What clear procedures will handle sensitive disclosures in group interviews (immediate facilitation scripts, post-session follow-up text, referral contacts, disclosure log) and a withdrawal cutoff point?
response.answer: Immediate facilitation scripts include confidentiality assurances; post-session follow-up texts check on participants; referral contacts provide support; disclosure logs track sensitive information. Withdrawal cutoff is 48 hours before session start.
